title: Prove ordered centre interfaces and price two complete D25 terminal constructions
body:
This PR adds enabling proofs for ordered centre controllers, a conditional physical coordinate compiler, and an exact 224-role construction over the regular D25 cover. It also gives a scoped negative result: both stated paid terminal constructions fail the native moment test for every positive improvement exponent. **There is no improvement to the complete kappa calculation.**

The [proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/4f2ef2e623de0aac147b43c03222f3e4a7ab6d2c/research/ordered-centre-interfaces/PROOF.md), [fresh replay receipt](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/4f2ef2e623de0aac147b43c03222f3e4a7ab6d2c/research/ordered-centre-interfaces/validation/REPLAY.json), [independent publication review](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/4f2ef2e623de0aac147b43c03222f3e4a7ab6d2c/research/publication-reviews/ordered-centre-interfaces/REVIEW.md), and [source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/4f2ef2e623de0aac147b43c03222f3e4a7ab6d2c/research/ordered-centre-interfaces/SOURCES.json) define the claim.

The raw and weighted controller normal forms hold for every positive pair count. The general-unit one-pair word gives `(-y,T x)`, where `T=E2 G1^-1 E0`. Its physical residual is `diag(Q T Q^-1,I)`. The multiplication order is part of the result. The theorem assumes the stated local responses and common-frame scalar access; a content inverse alone does not supply a native decoder or a retired-data view.

The physical compiler must change coordinates on the complete state, including helpers, and must keep every composed map inside the admitted grammar. Its line-flag result excludes the stated independent-path transfer; the finite canonical-prefix screen is not an exclusion of all stabilizer choices. A separate completion preserves 408 arbitrary helpers and their productive maps, with 2,326 children and rank mass 3,281. That completion is not an extra charge in the data-only D25 word.

The D25 construction has three calls of native rank mass 1,792 each. Either terminal adds **224**, so the complete mass is **5,600 = 224*25**. These are costs of two specified constructions, not a lower bound for all possible terminals.

| Terminal | Added terminal children | Complete native profile | Real scalar subtotal |
| --- | --- | --- | ---: |
| Separated | 224 rank-one children | `{1:704,2:144,5:144,7:336,8:192}` | 28,264 |
| Mixed | 96 rank-one and 64 rank-two children | `{1:576,2:208,5:144,7:336,8:192}` | 25,896 |

The mixed terminal saves 2,368 scalar primitives under the same scalar prices. Every child in both complete profiles has rank below 25, which proves the strict positive-moment failure. The scalar subtotals exclude the old signed exchange, global cover work, finite map prices, recursive storage, and precision. The mixed terminal has a separate count of 608 map calls; that count is not their finite operation price. A cheaper terminal remains possible.

Run from the repository root with Python 3.11 or later, its standard library, at least 3 GiB free disk, and a new output directory:

```sh
python3 -I -B research/ordered-centre-interfaces/replay.py --out /tmp/ordered-centre-replay
```

Expected final output:

```text
PASS_ORDERED_CENTRE_INTERFACES
```

All ten checks passed normally and with optimized Python. The independent review repeated all 20 runs in a Git-free copy with no executable search path and verified all 128 source inputs. Its separate exact checker verifies ordered unit identities, complete-state coordinate changes, all four 224-column data words, both paid profiles, 2,688 small symplectic compositions, and seven negative controls. The all-size statements come from the proofs. One portable checker reads an exact retained archive member; only its changed self-hash is excluded from the old receipt comparison. The [adaptation record](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/4f2ef2e623de0aac147b43c03222f3e4a7ab6d2c/research/ordered-centre-interfaces/PORTABLE-ADAPTATION.json) retains the original script and exact diff.

The raw native phase reviews, serial cover, row split, and LIFO contracts remain pinned premises. No full native phase sweep, selected-construction replay, all-size recursive compiler proof, finite map/tape invoice, precision proof, or exact integer-recovery proof was run.

The packaging base is [b58ad9ef4d4e861b0eaa5dba41742bdc072dca51](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/commit/b58ad9ef4d4e861b0eaa5dba41742bdc072dca51), which selects [PR #4470](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4470). This PR makes no applicability claim for that selected construction. The historical pins remain unchanged.

The coupled provider comes from [PR #3133](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3133) at [51eb9c4ee9e4722010d308aa3309e039d3940cc2](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/51eb9c4ee9e4722010d308aa3309e039d3940cc2/research/rank7-coupled-586-588-carrier-fold/README.md), whose source credits @dcharb78. The byte-equal provider copies come from Jeremy Diviney (@jeremydiviney) in [PR #3148](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3148) at [f2927a4b8afcf0701a6b945e14f30de1d94f5176](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/f2927a4b8afcf0701a6b945e14f30de1d94f5176/research/coupled-carrier-cap740/README.md). The exact Clifford implementation comes from [PR #2588](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2588) at [8cd9dc88e24f062e2ca2fa7f4844a3d3319381fb](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/8cd9dc88e24f062e2ca2fa7f4844a3d3319381fb/research/gmx-t74-borrow43-handoff/new/code/borrow/vendor/clifford/clifford_exact.py). The [notice](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/4f2ef2e623de0aac147b43c03222f3e4a7ab6d2c/research/ordered-centre-interfaces/NOTICE.md) preserves the full earlier credit and Apache-2.0 terms. Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance was used; the independent reviews are separate agent checks.
